name: Is ground-up construction more expensive than remodeling an existing home?

mainEntity.name: Is ground-up construction more expensive than remodeling an existing home?

acceptedAnswer.text: It can be more costly upfront, but ground-up work may be more efficient when an existing structure needs major structural, systems, and layout changes to meet your goals, and can yield better long-term performance. cubework+2
